blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Tironian notes are generally regarded as the first Latin shorthand system and are notable for their large, fine-grained symbol inventory.
Their high visual similarity and large class set make manual reading time-consuming, leaving manuscripts that contain Tironian notes inaccessible to many researchers.
Automatic recognition is also challenging because models must distinguish subtle differences in stroke shape and sign structure while realistic training data remain scarce.
However, standard flat classifiers do not explicitly use visual or structural relations between related signs.
This paper investigates whether structural relationships between Tironian notes can support automatic recognition.
We use the snt ( snt ) by Martin Hellmann, which provides idealized sign forms and a hierarchical organization of Tironian notes.
We compare flat ResNet18, ConvNeXt, swin ( swin ), and vit ( vit ) classifiers with hd-cnn ( hd-cnn )-style coarse-to-fine models and hierarchy-aware routing models based on visual class cleaning and similarity-based re-clustering.
The models are evaluated on handwritten samples and manuscript-domain samples from Vergilius Turonensis, both with and without limited few-shot adaptation to the manuscript domain.
The results show that the relative performance of flat and hierarchical models depends on adaptation.
On Vergilius Turonensis, hd-cnn achieves the best non-adapted Top-1 result with 45.43 %, while flat classification reaches the best Top-1 result after few-shot adaptation with 82.09 %.
Overall, the results indicate that hierarchical structure can support Tironian note recognition, especially under non-adapted conditions. Keywords: Tironian notes; historical document analysis; handwritten symbol recognition; hierarchical classification; HD-CNN; few-shot adaptation.
blocks.zh:
蒂罗尼亚笔记一般被认为是第一个拉丁语的短手系统,并因其庞大,精细的符号目录而显著.
他们的高度视觉相似性和大型类集使得手动读取耗时,使得包含提罗尼亚笔记的手稿被许多研究者无法访问.
自动识别也具有挑战性,因为模型必须区分中风形状和标志结构的细微差异,而现实的训练数据仍然很少.
然而,标准平面分类器没有明确使用相关标志之间的视觉或结构关系.
本文调查了蒂罗尼亚笔记之间的结构关系能否支持自动识别.
我们使用马丁·赫尔曼(Martin Hellmann)的snt(snt),它提供了理想化的标志形式和蒂罗尼亚笔记的等级组织.
我们比较了平坦的ResNet18,ConvNEXt,swin(swin),和vit(vit)分类器与hd-cnn(hd-cnn)风格的粗细至细细的模型以及基于视觉类清洁和相似性重排的分层意识的路由模型.
这些模型在Vergilius Turonensis的手写样本和手稿域标本上得到评价,无论是否对手稿领域进行了有限的几发修改。
结果显示,平面模型和等级模型的相对性能取决于适应.
在Vergilius Turonensis上,hd-cnn以45.43%的成绩实现了最佳的不适应Top-1,而平面分类在经过几发82.09%的适应后达到了最佳Top-1.
总体来看,结果显示等级结构可以支持Tironian音符的识别,特别是在不适应的条件下. 关键词 : Tironian notes; 历史文件分析; 手写符号识别; 等级分类; HD-CNN; 几发改编.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Tironian notes are an ancient Latin shorthand system that was widely used in medieval manuscripts in the early Middle Ages.
Unlike alphabetic writing systems, individual Tironian symbols typically represent complete words, word parts, or phrases rather than single letters [ 24 ] .
Because of this compact and specialized notation, manuscripts containing Tironian notes remain inaccessible to many researchers, as their interpretation typically requires highly specialized expertise [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh:
提罗尼亚笔记(Tironian notes)是古代拉丁语的简称系统,在中世纪早期的中世纪手稿中被广泛使用.
与字母书写系统不同,个别的提罗尼亚符号一般代表完整的单词,单词部分,或短语而非单字母[24].
由于这种紧凑和专门的注解,许多研究者仍然无法获得含有Tironian笔记的手稿,因为对其解释通常需要高度专业的专门知识[20].

blocks.en:
Historical reference materials exist, including the cnt ( cnt ) as an index of Tironian notes [ 24 ] and the more recent snt ( snt ) by Martin Hellmann, a digital hypertext lexicon in which Tironian symbols are organized hierarchically [ 7 ] .
This structure provides a basis for moving beyond flat classification and investigating whether visual and structural relationships between symbols can support automatic recognition.
blocks.zh:
历史参考材料存在,包括cnt(cnt)作为Tironian音符的索引[24],以及马丁·赫尔曼(Martin Hellmann)的较近的snt(snt),一种数字超文本词典,其中Tironian符号按等级排列[7].
这种结构为超越平面分类和调查符号之间的视觉和结构关系能否支持自动识别提供了基础.

blocks.en:
Automatic recognition remains challenging under realistic manuscript conditions.
The symbol inventory is large and fine-grained; many symbols are visually similar and differ only in subtle local stroke patterns or small structural variations.
Furthermore, there is a strong visual gap between clean standard symbols, modern handwritten samples, and historical manuscript crops.
Annotated manuscript-domain data are scarce, and historical manuscript images may exhibit background texture, degraded strokes, low contrast, and incomplete local details.
As a result, Tironian note recognition is not only a fine-grained image classification problem, but also a low-resource and domain-adaptation problem [ 14 ] .
blocks.zh:
在现实的手稿条件下,自动识别仍然具有挑战性。
符号目录大而精细;许多符号在视觉上相似,仅在细微的局部中风图案或小的结构变化中有所不同.
此外,在清洁的标准符号、现代手写样品和历史手稿作物之间存在着很大的视觉差距。
附加说明的手稿域数据很少,历史手稿图像可能显示出背景纹理,退化的中风,低对比度,以及不完整的局部细节.
因此,Tironian note的识别不仅是一个精细的图像分类问题,而且是一个低资源和域适应问题[14].

blocks.en:
Standard deep learning classifiers typically treat this task as flat multi-class classification, where each input image is mapped directly to one label from the full symbol inventory [ 6 , 13 , 12 , 4 ] .
This provides a strong baseline, but relations between visually or structurally related symbols are not explicitly encoded in the flat classification objective.
Coarse-to-fine and hierarchy-aware routing strategies offer an alternative by organizing the label space into broader groups before predicting fine-grained classes [ 26 , 28 ] .
In this study, both hierarchical strategies, Coarse-to-fine and hierarchy-aware routing, are built from visually generated clustering trees; each of them uses the tree structure differently. The hd-cnn ( hd-cnn ) model [ 28 ] uses only the lowest two levels of the generated tree: the leaf labels define the fine classes, while their immediate parent nodes define the coarse groups.
The hierarchy-aware routing model uses a deeper part of the generated tree and performs prediction as a sequence of local routing decisions through multiple hierarchy levels.
blocks.zh:
标准深层学习分类法一般将这项任务视为平面多类分类,其中每个输入图像直接映射到完整符号目录的一个标签[6,13,12,4].
这提供了一个强大的基线,但视觉或结构相关符号之间的关系并没有在平面分类目标中明确编码.
粗细到精细和有分层意识的路由策略提供了一个替代方案,在预测精细分类之前,将标签空间组织成更广泛的组别[26,28].
在这项研究中,分层策略,粗细到细细和分层认识的路由,都是从视觉生成的集群树上建造的;每种树的结构使用不同. hd-cnn (hd-cnn) 型号 [28] 仅使用生成树的最低两级:叶片标签定义细类,而其直接的母节点则定义粗组.
分级意识的路由模型使用生成的树的更深的部分,并通过多个层次来进行预测,作为局部路线决定的序列.

blocks.en:
This paper evaluates three recognition strategies for Tironian notes: flat classification, hd-cnn coarse-to-fine classification, and hierarchy-aware routing classification.
The experiments investigate whether structured approaches can support recognition under low-resource, manuscript-domain conditions, while also accounting for the potential instability introduced by additional routing decisions.
For the evaluation, clean standard symbols are used, along with augmented training data, modern handwritten notes, and expert-cropped manuscript symbols from Vergilius Turonensis [ 5 ] .
In addition, we study the effect of a limited few-shot adaptation to the manuscript domain.
The comparison focuses on recognition and Top-k performance.
blocks.zh:
本文评价了Tironian笔记的三个识别策略:平分分类,hd-cnn粗对细分分类,以及分级认识的路由分类.
实验研究了结构化方法是否能够支持在资源低、手稿领域条件下的识别,同时也考虑到额外路径决定带来的潜在不稳定性。
在评价时,使用干净的标准符号,同时使用强化训练数据,现代手写笔记,以及Vergilius Turonensis的专家拼写手稿符号[5].
此外,我们研究了对手稿域进行有限的几发改编的效果.
比较的重点是识别和Top-k性能.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Deep learning has been widely used in visual recognition and historical document analysis, where cnn ( cnn )s learn local visual patterns such as edges, strokes, curves, and shape fragments [ 10 , 9 ] .
For symbol recognition, these local patterns often determine the differences between visually similar classes.
Modern image classification architectures extend this principle in different ways. resnet ( resnet ) uses residual connections to enable the training of deeper convolutional networks [ 6 ] , while ConvNeXt updates convolutional architectures with design choices inspired by recent vision models [ 13 ] .
Transformer-based models such as vit and swin use self-attention to model relationships between image regions; swin further combines local shifted windows with a hierarchical feature design [ 4 , 12 ] .
blocks.zh:
深度学习被广泛用于视觉识别和历史文档分析,其中cnn(cnn)s学习了边缘,中风,曲线,形状碎片等局部视觉模式[10,9].
对于符号识别,这些局部模式往往决定视觉相似类之间的区别.
现代图像分类架构以不同的方式扩展了这一原则. resnet(resnet )使用剩余连接来进行更深层的演化网络训练[6],而ConvNEXt则以近期视觉模型启发的设计选择来更新演化架构. [13].
Vit和swin等基于变形器的模型使用自我意向来模拟图像区域之间的关系;swin进一步将本地变形窗口与等级特征设计相结合[4,12].

blocks.en:
Tironian note recognition follows the pattern of historical document recognition, which often involves limited annotated data, domain shifts, and degraded image quality [ 14 ] , and additionally works from clean standard forms, modern handwritten samples, as well as from historical manuscript crops that differ in background, contrast, stroke quality, and writing style.
Data augmentation is commonly used under such low-resource conditions to increase training-data variability [ 25 ] .
For handwritten symbol recognition, augmentation must preserve stroke structure because excessive geometric transformations can alter a symbol’s visual identity.
Chen et al. [ 1 ] propose a script-level augmentation method for few-shot handwritten text recognition, where generated variants preserve writing structure, which is relevant for Tironian notes as well, where small stroke-level modifications can heavily change the symbol’s meaning.
blocks.zh:
Tironian note识别遵循了历史文件识别的模式,这往往涉及有限的注释数据,域位移,和退化的图像质量[14],另外还有来自清洁标准形式,现代手写样本,以及背景,对比,中风质量,写作风格不同的历史手稿作物的作品.
数据扩增通常在这种低资源条件下使用,以增加培训数据可变性[25]。
对于手写符号识别,增强必须保留中风结构,因为过度的几何转换可以改变符号的视觉特征.
陈等. [1]为几发手写文字识别提出脚本级增强法,其中生成的变体保留了书写结构,这也与Tironian音符有关,小中风级修改可以极大地改变符号的含义.

blocks.en:
When labels can be organized into groups or multi-level structures, hierarchical classification provides an alternative to flat prediction [ 26 ] .
Instead of predicting directly over all labels, hierarchical methods divide recognition into broader and finer decisions.
Combining a shared feature extractor, a coarse classifier, and several fine-level specialist classifiers, hd-cnn serves as a representative coarse-to-fine visual recognition model where fine predictions are made within coarse category groups [ 28 ] .
Other neural hierarchical models use label structure differently.
Organizing classification through a tree-structured model, tree-cnn ( tree-cnn ) was introduced in the context of incremental learning [ 23 ] , whereas b-cnn ( b-cnn ) utilizes multiple classification branches corresponding to different hierarchy levels within a shared convolutional network [ 29 ] .
These approaches represent different ways of integrating label structure into neural recognition.
blocks.zh:
当标签可以组织成组或多层次结构时,分级分类提供了平面预测的替代品[26].
分级方法不是直接预测所有标签,而是将承认分为更广泛和更细微的决定。
hd-cnn结合了共用的特征提取器,粗细分类器,以及几个精细级的专家分类器,在粗细类组内进行精细预测的,hd-cnn作为具有代表性的粗细到细细的视觉识别模型[28].
其他神经等级模型使用标签结构不同.
通过树状结构模型组织分类,树-cnn(树-cnn)是在增量学习的背景下引入的[23],而b-cnn(b-cnn)则在共享的演化网络中利用与不同层次相对应的多个分类分支[29].
这些方法代表了将标签结构融入神经识别的不同方式.

blocks.en:
Not only does the performance of hierarchical classification depend on the model architecture, but it also depends on the label hierarchy.
Label tree learning studies how to arrange class labels into tree structures for efficient or structured prediction [ 3 ] .
Extreme classification methods such as Parabel and Bonsai also use label trees, with different choices of depth, balance, and tree diversity [ 21 , 8 ] .
For visually grounded hierarchy construction, agglomerative clustering can build nested groups from feature distances [ 18 , 22 ] .
Hierarchical inference methods further address how local tree decisions are combined into final predictions [ 11 , 27 ] .
Building on this work, this paper compares flat classifiers, hd-cnn -style two-level coarse-to-fine models, and hierarchy-aware routing models based on visually generated clustering trees.
blocks.zh:
分级分类的性能不仅取决于模型架构,还取决于标签等级.
标签树学研究如何将类标签排列成树结构,以便高效或有条理的预测[3].
Parabel和Bonsai等极端分类方法也使用标签树,在深度,平衡和树种多样性方面有不同的选择[21,8].
对于视网膜的层次构建,群集可以从特征距离[18,22]建立巢组.
分级推论方法进一步解决了如何将本地树决定结合到最终预测[11,27].
在这项工作的基础上,本文比较了平面分类法,hd-cnn - 风格的两级粗对细模型,以及基于视觉生成的集群树的分级意识路由模型.

blocks.en: 3 Data
blocks.zh: 3 数据

blocks.en:
The evaluation covers three main visual domains for Tironian note recognition: clean standard symbols from snt [ 7 ] , modern handwritten samples, and cropped historical Tironian notes from the Vergilius Turonensis manuscript [ 5 ] .
These sources differ in visual appearance, class coverage, origin, and role in the evaluation pipeline.
As additional training data, augmented variants of the snt standard symbols are used. Figure 1 shows representative examples from the three visual domains.
blocks.zh:
评估涵盖了Tironian音符识别的三个主要视觉领域: snt [7] 的清洁标准符号,现代手写样本,以及从Vergilius Turonensis手稿中裁剪的历史Tironian音符 [5].
这些来源在视觉外观,班级覆盖范围,来源,以及评价管道中的角色等方面各不相同.
作为额外培训数据,采用了snt标准符号的扩大变体。 图1显示了三个视觉领域的代表性实例。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Examples of visually corresponding Tironian symbols from the three main visual domains used in this paper: historical manuscript crops from Vergilius Turonensis [ 5 ] , modern handwritten samples from the internal handwritten notes dataset created by jgu Mainz and Heidelberg University, and clean standard forms from the snt [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 图1:本文使用的三个主要视觉领域的视觉对应Tironian符号的例子:Vergilius Turonensis的历史手稿作物[5],jgu Mainz和海德堡大学创建的内部手写笔记数据集的现代手写样本,以及snt[7]的清洁标准表单.

blocks.en:
Table 1 summarizes the image data sources used in the experiments. snt provides clean standard symbol images and metadata [ 7 ] . These standard images provide broad class coverage and are used for training and for constructing visual hierarchies.
Since many classes contain a small number of standard samples or even only one, augmented snt variants are generated to increase the amount of training data.
These generated samples are used for training and validation only and are not treated as an independent evaluation domain.
blocks.zh:
表1总结了实验中使用的图像数据来源. snt提供干净的标准符号图像和元数据[7]. 这些标准图像提供广泛的课堂覆盖,并用于培训和建造视觉等级。
由于许多课程包含少量的标准样本,甚至只有一个标准样本,因此生成了扩大的snt变体,以增加培训数据的数量.
这些生成的样本仅用于培训和验证,不作为独立评价领域处理。

blocks.zh: 表1:本文件使用的数据来源概览。

blocks.en:
In this paper, the hierarchical organization of Tironian symbols of the snt [ 7 ] is represented in a structured form and retained as a reference hierarchy.
It is, however, not used directly as the training hierarchy, since recognition strategies that require hierarchical grouping use visually generated clustering trees.
This separates the lexicon-based organization of the snt from the visual grouping for model evaluation.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,snt[7]的Tironian符号的等级组织以结构化的形式表示,并保留为参考等级.
但是,它并非直接用作培训等级,因为要求分级分组的识别战略使用视觉生成的集群树。
这将snt的基于词典的组织与用于模型评价的视觉分组区分开来.

blocks.en:
The handwritten notes dataset is an internal dataset and was created by jgu Mainz and Heidelberg University.
The modern handwritten reproductions of Tironian symbols on a clean background introduce variation in stroke shape, stroke thickness, and spatial arrangement, while avoiding the more pronounced degradation found in historical manuscript crops.
The modern dataset covers only a subset of the full snt label inventory and mainly contains the more frequent symbols.
It is used for training and for controlled-domain evaluation.
blocks.zh:
手写笔记数据集是一个内部数据集,由jgu Mainz和海德堡大学创建.
现代手写式复制清扫背景的提罗尼亚符号,引入了中风形状,中风厚度,空间安排等方面的变异,同时避免了历史手稿作物中发现的更显著的退化.
现代数据集仅涵盖完整snt标签目录的一个子集,主要包含更频繁的符号.
它用于培训和控制领域评价。

blocks.en:
The Vergilius Turonensis dataset contains cropped Tironian symbols from historical manuscript pages.
The original digitized manuscript is available through e-codices [ 5 ] , while the cropped dataset used in this paper was created before this study by jgu Mainz and Heidelberg University.
Compared with the standard and handwritten data, these crops contain background texture, uneven contrast, ink variation, degraded strokes, and incomplete local details.
Representative samples are shown in Fig. 2 .
This dataset was used for manuscript-domain evaluation and few-shot adaptation. A small subset of crops (24 samples) was excluded from the evaluation because their labels are not present in snt .
blocks.zh:
Vergilius Turonensis数据集包含来自历史手稿页的裁剪式提罗尼亚符号.
最初的数字化手稿通过电子编码[5]提供,而本文使用的裁剪数据集是jgu Mainz和海德堡大学在本研究之前创建的.
与标准数据和手写数据相比,这些作物含有背景纹理,对比不均匀,墨水变异,中风退化,局部细节不完整.
图2显示了代表性样本。
这个数据集被用于手稿域评测和几发改编. 一小部分作物(24个样品)被排除在评价之外,因为它们的标签没有Snt。

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation Pipeline and Recognition Strategies
blocks.zh: 4. 评价管道和确认战略

blocks.en:
This section describes the evaluation pipeline and the three recognition strategies compared in this paper.
The pipeline first standardizes the input images, cleans the snt label space, and expands the low-resource snt training data through augmentation.
Additionally, flat classifiers are trained as non-hierarchical baselines and also serve as feature extractors for visual clustering. knn ( knn ) is evaluated as an additional non-parametric baseline.
The resulting clustering trees are used in two ways: hd-cnn uses the leaf and immediate parent levels for coarse-to-fine classification, while the hierarchy-aware routing model uses a deeper tree structure for multi-level local decisions. Figure 3 summarizes the complete evaluation pipeline.
blocks.zh:
本节介绍本文件中比较的评价过程和三项承认战略。
管道首先将输入图像标准化,清理snt标签空间,并通过增强来扩展低资源snt训练数据.
此外,平面分类器被培训为非等级基线,也作为视觉集群的特征提取器. knn (knn) 被评价为额外的非参数基线。
由此形成的集群树有两种方式: hd-cnn使用叶片和直系亲层进行粗细至细细的分类,而分层知路模型则使用更深层的树结构进行多层次的地方决策. 图3汇总了完整的评价程序。

blocks.en:
Figure 3: Overview of the evaluation pipeline.
Input datasets are preprocessed and cleaned before training the flat model.
The trained flat model provides features for constructing the clustering tree, which is then used by the hd-cnn coarse-to-fine model and the hierarchy-aware routing model.
Few-shot adaptation is applied before final evaluation.
blocks.zh:
图3:评价程序概述。
输入数据集在训练平面模型前进行预处理和清理.
训练有素的平面模型为构建集群树提供了特征,然后被hd-cnn粗对细的模型和分级意识的路由模型使用.
在最后评价之前,很少采用直接的适应。

blocks.en: 4.1 Preprocessing and Data Augmentation
blocks.zh: 4.1 预处理和数据增强

blocks.en:
Before model training, the input images from different visual domains are normalized to reduce low-level variation.
For handwritten and manuscript-derived samples, images are converted to grayscale and filtered with a median blur to reduce isolated noise artifacts.
The binarization method is chosen based on the visual properties of each dataset.
For handwritten samples with a relatively uniform background, Otsu thresholding is used [ 19 ] , whereas for Vergilius Turonensis, where the background is more uneven, and the contrast varies across crops, K-means clustering with two intensity clusters is used to separate foreground strokes from background pixels.
blocks.zh:
在模型训练之前,不同视觉域的输入图像实现正常化,以减少低水平的变异.
对于手写和手稿生成的样本,图像被转换成灰度,并用中位模糊的滤光,以减少孤立的噪声文物.
根据每个数据集的视觉属性选择二进制方法.
对于背景相对统一的手写标本,使用Otsu阈值[19],而对于Vergilius Turonensis来说,背景比较不均衡,不同作物的对比度也不同,使用两个强度集群的K-意为将前缘中风与背景像素区分开来.

blocks.en:
After binarization, each symbol is placed on a square canvas using aspect-ratio-preserving padding and resized to 224 × \times 224 pixels.
This keeps the symbol shape from being stretched while providing a common input size for all evaluated backbones.
During training, moderate online transformations, including small rotations, translations, and scaling, are applied to increase variation without intentionally altering the symbol’s identity.
blocks.zh:
在二进制后,每个符号被放置在方形画布上,使用侧面-ratio-保留垫,并调整大小为224×\times 224像素.
这可以防止符号形状被拉伸,同时为所有被评价的骨干提供共同的输入大小.
在培训期间,将适度的在线转换,包括小旋转、翻译和缩放,用于增加变异,而无意改变符号的特性。

blocks.en:
In addition to image preprocessing, the snt label space is cleaned before training and hierarchy construction.
Some entries in the original inventory are historically or lexically distinct but visually nearly identical after normalization.
Since training an image classifier on such labels can introduce conflicting supervision, a conservative duplicate detection procedure is applied to the clean snt standard symbols.
Each image is converted to grayscale, resized to 64 × \times 64 pixels, and binarized with a fixed threshold of 128.
Candidate pairs are first filtered by ink ratio, defined as the proportion of black pixels.
Only pairs with an ink-ratio difference of less than 0.02 are compared further.
If their pixel-level similarity is at least 0.998, they are treated as visually equivalent.
For each duplicate group, one representative label is retained, and redundant labels are removed from the training label space.
blocks.zh:
除图像预处理外,Snt标签空间在培训和等级构建前被清理.
原始清单中的一些条目在历史上或逻辑上是不同的,但在正常化之后几乎是相同的。
由于在这类标签上培训图像分类器可以引入相互冲突的监督,因此对干净的snt标准符号适用保守的重复检测程序.
每个图像都转换成灰度,大小调整为64×\times 64像素,二进制后固定阈值为128.
候选配对首先通过墨水比过滤,定义为黑色像素的比例.
只有墨迹差小于0.02的对子才能进一步比较.
如果它们的像素水平的相似性至少为0.998,则视同为等效.
每个重复组保留一个代表性标签,从训练标签空间中删除多余的标签.

blocks.en:
Additional training samples are generated from the snt standard symbols to address the small number of available samples per class.
The augmentation follows the script-level sample generation approach for few-shot handwritten recognition proposed by Chen et al. [ 1 ] .
For each standard sample, 16 augmented variants are generated.
These samples are used as augmented snt training data and are not treated as a separate evaluation domain.
blocks.zh:
利用Snt标准符号生成更多的培训样本,以解决每班可用样本数量不多的问题。
增量采用Chen et al提出的几发手写识别的脚本级样本生成方法. [1].
每个标准样本产生16种增殖变体.
这些样本被用作强化培训数据,不作为单独的评价领域处理。

blocks.en: 4.2 Flat Classification Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.2 平面分类基线

blocks.en:
Flat classifiers treat all cleaned leaf labels as independent classes in a single output space.
A visual backbone extracts features from the input image, while a global classification layer directly predicts all target labels. Fig. 4 illustrates this flat prediction structure.
This setting provides the non-hierarchical baseline for exact Top-k recognition.
blocks.zh:
平面分类器将所有清洗的叶片标签作为独立的类,在一个输出空间中.
一个视觉主干从输入图像中提取特征,而全球分类层直接预测所有目标标签. 图4说明了这种平面预测结构。
此设定为准确的Top-k识别提供了非等级基线.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Flat classification strategy. After feature extraction, a single global classifier predicts directly over all cleaned leaf classes.
blocks.zh: 图4:平面分类战略。 经过特征提取后,一个单一的全球分类器会直接预测所有被清理的叶类.

blocks.en:
The flat baseline is implemented with four lightweight backbone variants: resnet 18, ConvNeXt-Tiny, swin -Tiny, and vit -Small.
They cover different visual families of modern recognition models: residual convolutional networks, modernized convolutional networks, self-attention models, and vision-based transformers [ 6 , 13 , 12 , 4 ] . Their approximate parameter counts are 11.7M, 28.6M, 28.3M, and 22.0M, respectively. All four backbones are initialized from ImageNet-pretrained weights.
The trained flat models also provide the feature representations used for the subsequent visual clustering step.
blocks.zh:
平面基线采用四个轻量级主干变体:resnet 18,ConvNEXt-Tiny,swin-Tiny,和vit-small.
它们涵盖了现代识别模型的不同视觉家族:残余的革命网络,现代化的革命网络,自觉模型,以及基于视觉的变压器[6,13,12,4]. 它们的近似参数计数分别为11.7M,28.6M,28.3M和22.0M. 所有四个骨干都从ImageNet预限权重中初始化.
训练有素的平面模型还提供了用于后续视觉集群步骤的特征表示.

blocks.en:
All flat models are trained with AdamW [ 16 ] using a weight decay of 0.05 0.05 .
The initial learning rate is set separately for each architecture within the range of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} to 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} .
Additionally, a cosine learning-rate schedule with warm-up is used, with a minimum learning rate of 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} [ 15 ] .
Training is performed for 50 epochs with automatic mixed precision [ 17 ] .
To handle class imbalance, the cross-entropy loss uses inverse-frequency class weights, and label smoothing with a factor of 0.1 0.1 is applied.
blocks.zh:
所有平面模型都使用亚当W[16]进行训练,使用重量衰变0.050.05.
在1×10−4 1\time 10×4}到5×10−4 5\time 10×4}范围内,每个建筑的初始学习率分别设定.
此外,还采用了带有热身的余弦学习率表,最低学习率为1×10−6 1×6 10×6}[15]。
对50个世纪进行自动混合精度[17]的培训。
为了处理类的不平衡,跨直径损失采用反频类的重量,并应用0.1系数的平滑标签.

blocks.en:
For manuscript-domain adaptation, the trained models are fine-tuned on a small subset of Vergilius Turonensis.
The few-shot protocol is deliberately kept limited to reduce overfitting: Classes with more than five samples provide three fine-tuning samples; classes with exactly five samples provide two samples; classes with two to four samples provide one sample; and singleton classes are kept only for testing.
In total, 117 Vergilius samples from 67 classes are used for fine-tuning and removed from the final evaluation set, leaving 550 test samples across 131 classes.
The same few-shot protocol is applied to the flat, hd-cnn , and hierarchy-aware routing models.
blocks.zh:
对于手稿-域改编,经过训练的模型在Vergilius Turonensis的一个小子集上进行了微调.
少数射击协议被刻意限制,以减少过度配色: 具有5个以上样本的类别提供3个微调样本;具有5个准确样本的类别提供2个样本;具有2至4个样本的类别提供1个样本;单吨级仅保留测试.
共有67个班级的117个Vergilius样本被用于微调,并从最终评价集中移除,使131个班级的550个测试样本.
同样的几发协议被应用于平,hd-cnn,和分级意识的路由模型.

blocks.en: 4.3 Visual Clustering for Hierarchical Grouping
blocks.zh: 4.3 等级组合的视觉集群

blocks.en: The snt provides a lexicon-based reference structure for Tironian notes and is retained as an external reference for group-level evaluation. However, the hierarchical groupings used by the recognition models are generated from visual feature similarity. This keeps the grouping aligned with the image recognition task.
blocks.zh: snt为Tironian笔记提供了基于词典的参考结构,并被保留作为集团级评价的外部参考. 然而,识别模型所使用的等级分组是由视觉特征的相似性产生的. 这使得分组与图像识别任务保持一致.

blocks.en:
A trained flat model is used as a feature extractor by removing its final classification head.
For each retained snt class, a feature vector is extracted from the representative standard symbol image.
The feature vectors 𝒙 \bm{x} are L2-normalized ( 𝒙 ^ \hat{\bm{x}} ), and pairwise cosine distances are computed as

一个训练有素的平面模型通过删除其最终分类头来作为特征提取器.
对于每个保留snt类,从代表性的标准符号图像中提取一个特征矢量.
特性向量 x\ bm{x} 是 L2- 正常化( x ^\ t\ bm{x}) , 双向余弦距离 计算为

blocks.en:
The resulting distance matrix D D is used for agglomerative clustering with average linkage [ 18 , 22 ] .
Average linkage defines the distance between two clusters as the average pairwise distances between their members, providing a balanced grouping criterion for visually related classes.
blocks.zh:
由此形成的距离矩阵D用于平均连结[18,22]的群集.
平均联系将两个组之间的距离定义为其成员之间的平均对等距离,为视觉相关类提供了平衡的分组标准.

blocks.en:
The clustering tree is generated recursively.
For the resnet 18-based tree, a distance-threshold strategy is used, with the threshold adjusted across hierarchy depth.
For ConvNeXt, swin , and vit features, the same threshold-based strategy produced excessively deep and unbalanced trees. A dynamic K K strategy is therefore used to control the local branching factor.
For a node containing N N classes, the target number of child clusters is set to K = ⌈ N ⌉ K=\bigl\lceil\sqrt{N}\,\bigr\rceil .
For implementation, each resulting clustering tree is stored as a nested structure and provides the visual label organization used by both non-flat recognition strategies.
blocks.zh:
集群树是递归生成的.
对于基于resnet 18的树,采用距离阈值策略,阈值在跨层级深度上进行调整.
对于ConvNEXt,swin,和vit的特征,同样的基于门槛的战略产生了过深和不平衡的树木. 因此使用动态K K策略来控制本地分支因子.
对于包含 N 类的节点,孩子群的目标数被设定为 K = ⌈ N K =\ bigl\lceil\sqrt{ N}\,\bigr\rceil 。
为了执行,每个产生的集群树都作为嵌套结构存储,并提供两个非平面识别策略使用的视觉标签组织.

blocks.en: Figure 5: hd-cnn -style coarse-to-fine classification strategy. A shared backbone feeds a coarse classifier that predicts the parent group, while group-specific specialist classifiers predict among the corresponding fine classes.
blocks.zh: 图5: hd-cnn-风格粗细分类策略. 共享骨干为粗重的分类器提供素材,预测母组,而特定组的专家分类器则在相应的细类中预测.

blocks.en: 4.4 hd-cnn Coarse-to-Fine Classification
blocks.zh: 4.4 hd-cnn (韩语). 粗到细分类

blocks.en:
hd-cnn is used as a two-level coarse-to-fine recognition strategy [ 28 ] .
In this setting, the two-level label structure is derived from the generated visual clustering tree.
The leaf labels define the fine classes, while the immediate parent nodes of these leaves define the coarse symbol groups.
Each fine class is therefore mapped to one coarse group.
blocks.zh:
hd-cnn作为两级粗对细识别策略[28].
在此设置中,双层标签结构来源于生成的视觉集群树.
叶片标签定义了细的类,而这些叶片的直接母节点则定义了粗细的符号组.
因此,每个精细的类别被绘制成一个粗体组。

blocks.en:
The model consists of a shared visual backbone, one coarse classifier, and several fine-level specialist classifiers. Figure 5 shows the hd-cnn -style coarse-to-fine structure used in this paper.
During training, the model receives both the coarse group label and the fine leaf label.
The coarse classifier predicts the parent group of the input symbol, while each specialist classifier distinguishes only the fine classes assigned to one parent group.
blocks.zh:
该模型包括一个共享的视觉骨干,一个粗细的分类器,以及几个精细级的专家分类器. 图5显示本文中使用的hd-cnn-风格粗细结构。
在训练期间,该型号同时获得粗细的组标签和细叶标签.
粗体分类器预测输入符号的母组,而每个专家分类器只区分分配给一个母组的细类.

blocks.en:
During inference, each leaf class receives a global score by combining the probability of its coarse group with the probability assigned by the corresponding fine specialist.
This produces a ranked prediction list across all fine classes, so the model can be evaluated using the same Top-1, Top-5, Top-10, and Top-30 metrics as the flat classifiers.
Compared with deeper routing, this two-level structure uses hierarchical information while limiting the number of sequential decisions.
blocks.zh:
在推论期间,每个叶类通过结合其粗体组的概率和相应的精细专家分配的概率,得到一个全局分数.
由此产生了所有细类的排名预测列表,因此该模型可以使用相同的Top-1,Top-5,Top-10,以及Top-30的度量衡作为平分分类器进行评价.
与更深层次的路由相比,这种两级结构使用等级信息,同时限制顺序决定的数量.

blocks.en: 4.5 Hierarchy-Aware Routing Classification
blocks.zh: 4.5 等级-知情程序分类

blocks.en:
The hierarchy-aware routing model uses a deeper part of the generated clustering tree.
Instead of using a single global output layer to predict all classes directly, the model replaces the flat classifier with node-specific routing classifiers.
Each internal node of the tree has its own classifier, and each classifier predicts among the child nodes of that internal node.
A prediction is obtained by following a sequence of local routing decisions from the root of the tree towards a leaf class. Figure 6 illustrates this hierarchy-aware routing strategy.
blocks.zh:
层次意识的路由模型使用生成的集群树更深的部分.
该模型不使用单一的全局输出层来直接预测所有类,而是用节点专用的路由分类器来取代平面分类器.
树的每个内部节点都有自己的分类器,每个分类器在那个内部节点的孩子节点中预测.
通过遵循从树根到叶类的局部路线决定的顺序来得到预测. 图6说明了这种分级认识的路线战略。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Hierarchy-aware routing classification strategy. The model follows local routing decisions through a deeper clustering tree and retains top-ranked candidate paths during beam-search inference.
blocks.zh: 图6:分级认识路线分类策略. 该模型通过更深的集群树遵循本地的路由决定,并在光束搜索推断时保留排名最高的候选人路径.

blocks.en:
During training, each ground-truth label is converted into its target path in the clustering tree.
Only the routing classifiers along this target path contribute to the loss.
Since the generated trees are not necessarily balanced, different leaf classes may have target paths of different lengths.
A simple sum of local losses would give deeper paths a larger contribution.
To reduce this depth-related imbalance, the model uses a path-normalized hierarchical loss:
blocks.zh:
在训练期间,每个地面真实的标签在集群树上转换成目标路径.
只有沿着这个目标路径的路由分类器造成了损失.
由于生成的树木不一定均衡,不同的叶类可能具有不同长度的目标路径.
简单的当地损失总和将给更深的途径带来更大的贡献。
为了减少这种与深度有关的不平衡,该模型采用了路径正常的等级损失:

The final batch loss is obtained by averaging the normalized sample losses.
Node-specific class weights can also be used inside local routing classifiers when the child branches of a node are imbalanced.

During inference, greedy prediction and beam search are used in different phases.
Greedy inference follows the locally highest-scoring child at each node, while beam search retains several candidate paths and therefore provides a more robust estimate of the final leaf prediction.
The hierarchy-aware routing model is evaluated at the leaf level with the same Top-k metrics as the other strategies.
In addition, group-level scores are reported for the routing model to examine whether incorrect leaf predictions still remain within related visual groups derived from the reference hierarchy.
blocks.zh:
在推论期间,贪婪的预测和光束搜索在不同阶段使用.
贪婪的推论跟随每个节点的本地得分最高的孩子,而光束搜索则保留了几种候选路径,因此为最终的叶子预测提供了更可靠的估计.
分级认识的路由模型在叶子层次上用与其他策略相同的Top-k度量衡来评价.
此外,还报告分组级分数,用于路由模型,以检查不正确的叶子预测是否仍然保留在从参考层级衍生出来的相关视觉组中.

blocks.en: 5 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5. 结果和讨论

blocks.en:
This section reports Top-k accuracies for flat classification, hd-cnn coarse-to-fine classification, and hierarchy-aware routing classification.
Since handwritten performance is near-perfect in most, the discussion focuses on Vergilius Turonensis, which represents the strongest domain shift.
All values are Top-k accuracies in percent. Results are averaged over four runs, except for hd-cnn , which was averaged over three runs.
blocks.zh:
本节报告 平面分类的顶级-克级分类法,hd-cnn粗到细的分类法,以及分级认识的路线分类法.
由于手写性能在大多数情况下都接近完美,因此讨论的重点是Vergilius Turonensis,它代表了最强的域移.
所有数值均以百分率计算。 除了hd-cnn(平均为3次)外,结果平均为4次。

blocks.en:
For the hierarchy-aware experiments, results are reported at the leaf level and, where applicable, at the group level.
Cluster-group accuracy is computed using the visual clustering tree generated during training. snt -group accuracy uses the structured representation of the snt reference hierarchy as an external comparison.
This metric is interpreted cautiously, because repeated or overlapping parent assignments make it more permissive than the generated cluster-group metric.
blocks.zh:
对于分级认识实验,结果在叶子一级报告,在适用的情况下,在组一级报告。
集群精度是利用训练期间产生的视觉集群树计算的. snt - 组精度使用snt参考层次的结构化表示作为外部比较.
这一衡量标准得到谨慎的解释,因为重复或重叠的母任务使得它比生成的分组衡量标准更加宽容。

blocks.en: 5.1 Flat Classification
blocks.zh: 5.1 平面分类

blocks.en:
The flat classifiers provide the non-hierarchical baseline.
Tables 2 and 3 show the results without, and with few-shot fine-tuning.
blocks.zh:
平面分类法提供了非等级基线.
表2和表3显示的是无结果,并且少发微调。

blocks.en: Table 2: Flat classification performance without few-shot fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 表2:平面分类性能没有几发微调.

blocks.en:
Without few-shot fine-tuning, the flat models achieve very high accuracy on the handwritten test set, with Top-1 between 98.99 % and 99.36 %.
In contrast, Top-1 accuracy on Vergilius Turonensis ranges only between 36.28 % and 43.82 %.
This confirms that clean handwritten recognition and historical manuscript recognition behave differently.
The manuscript crops contain uneven background texture, lower contrast, degraded strokes, incomplete local details, and stronger ambiguity between visually similar symbols.
blocks.zh:
没有几发微调,平面模型在手写测试集上实现了极高的精度,Top-1在98.99%至99.36%之间.
相比之下,Vergilius Turonensis上的Top-1精度在36.28%至43.82%之间.
这证实了干净的手写识别和历史手稿识别行为不同.
手稿作物中含有不均匀的背景纹理,对比度较低,中风退化,局部细节不完整,视觉上相似符号之间的模糊度更强.

blocks.en:
Few-shot fine-tuning substantially improves the manuscript-domain recognition for all flat models.
On Vergilius Turonensis, Top-1 accuracy increases from 36.28 % to 68.73 % for resnet 18, from 40.37 % to 79.14 % for ConvNeXt, from 43.82 % to 82.09 % for swin , and from 42.62 % to 81.77 % for vit .
The handwritten results remain close to the maximum value, so the main effect of target-domain transfer is visible on Vergilius Turonensis.
These results show that even limited manuscript-domain supervision helps the models adapt to manuscript-specific background, stroke, and contrast conditions.
blocks.zh:
很少镜头的微调大大改善了所有平面模型的手稿域识别.
在Vergilius Turonensis上,Top-1的精度从36.28%上升到68.73%的转网18,ConvNEXt的精度从40.37%上升到79.14%,Swin的精度从43.82%上升到82.09%,Vit的精度从42.62%上升到81.77%.
手写结果仍然接近最大值,因此目标域转移的主要效果可见于Vergilius Turonensis.
这些结果显示,即使是有限的手稿域监督也帮助模型适应手稿特有的背景,中风,以及对比条件.

blocks.en: Table 3: Flat classification performance after few-shot fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 表3:几发微调后平分性能.

blocks.en: Pixel-level knn reaches 90.12% accuracy on the handwritten data but only 4.20% on the Vergilius data. Feature-based knn improves performance on Vergilius to 38.83%, but its performance remains limited.
blocks.zh: 像素级knn在手写数据上达到90.12%的精度,但在Vergilius数据上只有4.20%. 基于特色的knn在Vergilius上将性能提升到38.83%,但其性能仍然有限.

blocks.en: To account for the class imbalance in the evaluation sets, balanced accuracy is additionally considered. For the best flat model on Vergilius, swin achieves 43.82% Top-1 accuracy without few-shot adaptation, while its balanced accuracy is 29.37%. After few-shot adaptation, swin reaches 82.09% Top-1 accuracy and 51.13% balanced accuracy. The lower balanced scores indicate that rare classes remain more challenging, although few-shot adaptation still improves performance across the class distribution.
blocks.zh: 为了考虑到评价组的类别不平衡,还额外考虑了平衡的准确性。 对于Vergilius上最好的平面模型,swin在没有几发修改的情况下达到了43.82%的Top-1精度,而它的平衡精度是29.37%. 经过几弹改造,Swin达到82.09%的Top-1精度和51.13%的平衡精度. 较低的平衡分数表明,稀有类仍然更具挑战性,尽管很少的镜头改编仍然能提高全类分布的性能.

blocks.en: 5.2 Hierarchy-Aware Routing Classification
blocks.zh: 5.2 等级 -- -- 预留分类

blocks.en:
The hierarchy-aware routing experiments compare self-generated trees, a shared tree from ImageNet-pretrained resnet 18 features [ 2 , 6 ] , and a shared tree from the trained resnet 18 flat classifier.
The self-generated setting allows each backbone to use its own feature space, while the shared-tree settings keep the hierarchy fixed across backbones.
blocks.zh:
分级认识的路由实验比较了自生树,ImageNet-pressed renet 18特性的共享树[2,6],以及训练有素的renet 18平面分类器的共享树.
自我生成的设置允许每个骨干使用自己的特征空间,而共享树的设置则保持跨骨干固定的等级.

blocks.en: This shared-tree setting is used to keep the hierarchy fixed across backbones, so that the comparison is not confounded by independently generated tree structures. resnet 18 is chosen as the reference because it serves as the lightweight convolutional baseline and provides a simple common feature space for constructing the shared hierarchy. This choice is not based on its flat classification accuracy and does not imply that the resnet 18-derived tree is globally optimal. The pretrained and trained resnet 18 trees further allow us to compare generic and task-adapted visual features.
blocks.zh: 这种共享-树的设置被用于将等级固定在主干上,这样比较就不会被独立生成的树结构所混淆. resnet 18被选为参考,因为它作为轻量级的演化基线,为构建共享等级提供了简单的共同特征空间. 这一选择并非基于其平坦的分类精度,也不意味着resnet 18衍生树是全球最佳的. 预先训练和训练有素的再网18棵树进一步使我们能够比较通用和适应任务的视觉特征.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Leaf-level Top-1 accuracy of hierarchy-aware models with self-generated clustering trees after few-shot fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 图7:叶层顶-1精度分级感知模型,经几弹微调后,自生集成树.

blocks.en:
Figure 7 summarizes the self-generated tree setting after few-shot fine-tuning.
The handwritten results remain high for all models, whereas the Vergilius Turonensis results show clearer differences between the backbones.
In this setting, ConvNeXt obtains the highest Top-1 accuracy on Vergilius Turonensis.
blocks.zh:
图7总结了经过几弹微调后自行生成的树种设置.
手写结果对于所有模型来说仍然很高,而Vergilius Turonensis的结果表明骨干之间的差别更明显.
在此设定中,ConvNEXt在Vergilius Turonensis上获得了最高的Top-1精度.

blocks.en:
The main shared-tree setting uses the clustering tree generated from the trained resnet 18 flat model. Table 4 summarizes the Vergilius Turonensis results without, and with few-shot fine-tuning.
To keep the table compact, only Top-1 and Top-30 values are shown.
blocks.zh:
主共享树设置使用由训练有素的resnet 18平面模型生成的集群树. 表4总结了Vergilius Turonensis的结果,没有,也没有几发微调。
为了保持表格紧凑,只显示Top-1和Top-30的值.

blocks.en: Table 4: Hierarchy-aware routing performance on Vergilius Turonensis using the shared tree generated from the trained resnet 18 flat model.
blocks.zh: 表4:利用训练有素的resnet 18平面模型生成的共享树,在Vergilius Turonensis上的分级-意识路由性能.

blocks.en:
Few-shot fine-tuning improves hierarchy-aware results across all four backbones, but it does not consistently outperform flat classification at the leaf level.
Group-level scores are usually higher than the corresponding leaf-level scores, indicating that some errors remain within visually or structurally related groups.
One possible reason is error propagation: if an early routing decision selects an incorrect branch, the final prediction is restricted to that part of the tree.
blocks.zh:
少镜头的微调改进了所有四个骨干体的分级感知结果,但是在叶子层次上并没有一贯的超越平面分类.
组级分数通常高于相应的叶级分数,表明一些错误仍然存在于视觉或结构相关的组内.
一个可能的原因是错误传播:如果一个早期的路由决定选择了一个不正确的分支,最终预测仅限于树的这一部分.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Comparison of different clustering tree sources on Vergilius Turonensis after few-shot fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 图8 Vergilius Turonensis上经过几发微调后的不同组群树源比较.

blocks.en:
Figure 8 compares the three tree sources after few-shot fine-tuning.
For ConvNeXt, swin , and vit , the shared tree generated from the trained resnet 18 flat model performs better than that generated from resnet 18 pretrained features.
This suggests that task-adapted visual features provide a more suitable hierarchy than generic pretrained features for the Tironian notes recognition task.
blocks.zh:
图8比较了经过几弹微调后的三棵树源.
对于ConvNEXt,swin,和vit,由训练有素的resnet 18平面模型生成的共享树,其性能优于由resnet 18预训特性生成的共享树.
这表明适应任务的视觉特征为蒂罗尼亚笔记识别任务提供了比通用的预训特征更合适的层次.

blocks.en: 5.3 hd-cnn Coarse-to-Fine Classification
blocks.zh: 5.3 hd-cnn (韩语). 粗到细分类

blocks.en: Table 5 shows the hd-cnn results on Vergilius Turonensis. The models use a two-level coarse-to-fine structure derived from the lowest levels of the generated clustering tree.
blocks.zh: 表5显示Vergilius Turonensis的hd-cnn结果。 模型使用一种从生成的集群树的最低水平衍生出来的两级粗细结构.

blocks.en: Table 5: hd-cnn coarse-to-fine classification performance on Vergilius Turonensis.
blocks.zh: 表5:Vergilius Turonensis上的hd-cnn粗细分类性能.

blocks.en:
Without few-shot adaptation, hd-cnn compares favorably with flat classification on Vergilius Turonensis.
It improves Top-1 accuracy for resnet 18, swin , and vit , with the highest performance achieved by swin at 45.43 %.
ConvNeXt is the exception in which the flat classifier performs better.
However, after few-shot fine-tuning, the flat models show stronger performance in the manuscript domain than hd-cnn .
This indicates that the relative advantage of coarse-to-fine classification depends on the adaptation setting.
blocks.zh:
没有几发的适应,hd-cnn在Vergilius Turonensis上与扁平的分类相比是有利的.
它提高了Top-1对resnet 18的精度,swin,和vit的精度,以45.43%的Swin达到最高的性能.
ConvNEXt是平面分类器表现较好的例外.
然而,经过几弹微调后,平面模型在手稿域表现出比hd-cnn更强的性能.
这表明粗细分类的相对优势取决于适应环境.

blocks.en: The comparison with hierarchy-aware routing suggests that the shallow two-level hd-cnn structure is more stable than deeper routing in the reported results on the manuscript domain. hd-cnn uses the generated tree only to define coarse groups and fine classes, while the routing model follows several local decisions through a deeper tree, which reduces the number of sequential decisions in hd-cnn and limits the effect of early routing errors.
blocks.zh: 与分级意识路由的比较表明,浅二层hd-cnn结构比手稿域上报告的结果更稳定. hd-cnn只使用生成的树来定义粗小的组和细小的类,而路由模型通过更深的树来遵循多个局部决定,这减少了hd-cnn中顺序决定的数量,限制了早期路由错误的影响.

blocks.en: Figure 9: Top-k accuracy of swin -based models on Vergilius Turonensis without few-shot.
blocks.zh: 图9:Vergilius Turonensis上基于swin的模型的Top-k精度,没有几发子弹.

blocks.en: Table 6: Representative misclassified examples, including manuscript crops from Vergilius Turonensis [ 5 ] and corresponding standard symbols from snt [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 表6:代表性错误分类的例子,包括Vergilius Turonensis的手稿作物[5]和snt[7]的相应标准符号.

blocks.en: Figure 9 provides a swin -based Top-k comparison between the three recognition strategies before few-shot adaptation. hd-cnn achieves the highest Top-1 and Top-5 accuracies in this comparison, while the flat swin classifier obtains slightly higher Top-10 and Top-30 results. This suggests that the coarse-to-fine structure can improve the highest-ranked predictions, although the flat model still retains stronger broader candidate coverage at larger Top-k values.
blocks.zh: 图9提供了三种识别战略之间基于Swin-Top-k的比较,然后才进行几率调整。 hd-cnn在这个比较中实现了最高的Top-1和Top-5的速率,而扁平的swin分类器获得略高的Top-10和Top-30的成绩. 这表明粗对细结构可以改进排名最高的预测,尽管平面模型仍然保留了更大的Top-k值的更广阔的候选覆盖.

blocks.en: 5.4 Error Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.4 错误分析

blocks.en:
Representative challenging examples are shown in Table 6 .
Each row presents a manuscript sample, the flat and hierarchy-aware predictions, the standard symbol and the true-label rank. The examples illustrate visually ambiguity in the manuscript domain: some crops resemble symbols with different labels or differ strongly from the standard symbols. In the first two examples, the hierarchy-aware models ranks the true label higher than flat models. This may because hierarchical models narrow the prediction to a visually related subgroup, which can help keep similar candidates closer together. In the last example the true label is outside the Top-30 candidates for both models. This suggests that some errors are caused by ambiguous manuscript evidence.
blocks.zh:
具有代表性的具有挑战性的例子见表6。
每行都呈现一个手稿样本,平面和层次意识的预测,标准符号和真标签的排名. 例子说明了手稿域的视觉模糊性:一些农作物类似标志,标签不同,或与标准符号有很大不同. 在前两个例子中,分级意识模型将真实的标签排序高于平面模型. 这可能是因为分级模型将预测范围缩小到一个视觉相关分组,这有助于使类似的候选人更接近。 在最后一个例子中,真实的标签在TOP-30两个型号的候选者之外. 这表明一些错误是由模棱两可的手稿证据造成的.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Outlook
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和展望

blocks.en:
This paper investigated Tironian note recognition as a low-resource visual classification problem using clean snt standard symbols, augmented snt samples, modern handwritten notes, and manuscript crops from Vergilius Turonensis.
The study compared flat classification, hd-cnn -style coarse-to-fine classification, and hierarchy-aware routing classification under comparable training and few-shot adaptation conditions.
blocks.zh:
这份论文调查了Tironian note识别为低资源视觉分类问题,使用干净的snt标准符号,增强snt样本,现代手写笔记,以及Vergilius Turonensis的手稿作物.
该研究比较了平面分类,hd-cnn - 风格粗对细的分类,以及可比培训和几发适应条件下的分级意识路线分类.

blocks.en:
The results show that the visual domain has a strong influence on recognition performance, since all strategies achieve high accuracy on the cleaner handwritten test set, while the recognition on the Vergilius Turonensis remains substantially more difficult because of background texture and degraded strokes.
Without few-shot adaptation, hd-cnn performs competitively and achieves the best Top-1 accuracy.
However, after few-shot adaptation, flat models achieve the strongest performance in the manuscript domain, showing that even limited target-domain supervision is highly effective.
blocks.zh:
结果显示,视觉域对识别性能有很强的影响,因为所有策略在更清洁的手写测试集上都取得了很高的准确性,而Vergilius Turonensis上的识别由于背景纹理和退化的中风,仍然要困难得多.
没有几发的改编,hd-cnn的性能具有竞争力,并取得了最佳的Top-1精度.
然而,经过几弹的改造后,平面模型在手稿领域取得了最强的性能,表明即使是有限的目标领域监督也非常有效.

blocks.en:
The hierarchy-aware routing model does not consistently improve final leaf-level recognition in the current setting, which suggests that deeper routing can introduce additional instability when early decisions send samples into incorrect branches.
Nevertheless, the group-level results are useful for analyzing whether errors remain within visually or structurally related symbols, which is important for Tironian notes.
blocks.zh:
分级感知的路由模型在目前的设置中并不一致地改进了最终的叶位识别,这说明更深的路由在早期决定将样本送入不正确的分支时会带来额外的不稳定性.
尽管如此,组级结果对于分析是否在视觉或结构相关符号中存在错误是有用的,这对Tironian的注释很重要.

blocks.en:
The main limitations are the small amount of annotated manuscript-domain samples, the focus on a single manuscript source, and the dependence of non-flat models on the quality of the visual clustering tree.
Future work should, therefore, evaluate the approaches on additional manuscripts, increase coverage for rare symbols, and investigate hierarchy construction methods that combine learned visual similarity with the snt reference structure and historical knowledge.
blocks.zh:
主要限制是附加说明的手稿域标本数量少,注重单一手稿来源,非平面模型对视觉集群树质量的依赖.
因此,今后的工作应当评价关于增加手稿的方法,扩大稀有符号的覆盖范围,并调查将所学视觉相似性与est参考结构和历史知识相结合的等级构建方法。

blocks.en:
Overall, the results indicate that hierarchical structure can support Tironian note recognition, especially for error analysis and non-adapted recognition.
Its final accuracy depends on tree construction, routing depth, backbone architecture, and the amount of available supervision in the manuscript domain.
blocks.zh:
总体来看,结果显示等级结构可以支持Tironian音符识别,特别是用于错误分析和非适应性识别.
其最终准确性取决于树构筑,路由深度,骨干架构,以及手稿领域可用的监管量.

blocks.en: S1.2 Additional KNN Retrieval Baselines
blocks.zh: S1.2 额外的 KNN 检索基线

blocks.en: Additional K-nearest-neighbor retrieval baselines are reported to complement the trainable neural baselines. These baselines include five variants. The first variant is a raw pixel-level KNN baseline. Each image is converted to a binarized 64 × 64 64\times 64 representation and flattened into a 4096-dimensional vector. The other four variants are feature-based KNN baselines, where feature representations are extracted from the trained ResNet18, ConvNeXt-Tiny, Swin-Tiny, and ViT-Small flat backbones. These variants test whether the learned visual feature spaces are sufficient for nearest-neighbor retrieval without using the trained classifier heads. For all KNN variants, the reference gallery consists of the cleaned SNT standard symbols together with the handwritten training and validation samples. All reference vectors and test vectors are L2-normalized, and cosine similarity is used for nearest-neighbor ranking. For Top- k k evaluation, the ranked neighbors are scanned in descending similarity order, and the first k k unique class labels are used as candidate predictions. Since KNN is a deterministic retrieval method without trainable classifier parameters, it is not included in the few-shot fine-tuning protocol.
blocks.zh: 据报道,额外的K-近邻检索基线是对可训练神经基线的补充。 这些基线包括五个变种. 第一个变体是原始像素级的KNN基线. 每个图像被转换成一个二进制的64×64 64\times 64表示器,并被平整成4096维向量. 另外四个变体是基于特征的KNN基线,其中从训练有素的ResNet18,ConvNEXt-Tiny,Swin-Tiny,以及ViT-Small平坦骨干中提取特征表示. 这些变体测试所学的视觉特征空间是否足以不使用训练有素的分类器头进行近邻检索. 对于所有KNN变体,参考画廊由清理的SNT标准符号以及手写训练和验证样本组成. 所有参考向量和测试向量都是L2-正态的,Cosine相似性用于近邻排名. 对于Top-k k评价,排名的邻居在降序相似性顺序中被扫描,第一个k k 独特的类标签被用作候选预测. 由于KNN是一种没有可训练的分类器参数的确定性检索方法,因此它没有包括在几发微调协议中.
